sections.heading: Use of Service
sections.paragraph: You agree to use our system for lawful purposes only, and not to infringe others' rights or cause system damage.

sections.heading: Booking and Payment
items: A booking is completed once all information is provided and payment is successful.
The booking reference and details will be sent via LINE or email within 5 minutes after payment confirmation.
If no confirmation is received, please contact our team within 24 hours.

sections.heading: Cancellation and Refunds
items: Cancellations or refunds are subject to the airline's or service provider's policy.
Processing fees may apply as specified in the booking details.

sections.heading: Privacy (PDPA)
items: Personal data is collected, used, and disclosed for specified purposes only.
You may withdraw consent, which may affect some services.
See the full policy on the Privacy Policy page.

sections.heading: Changes to Terms
sections.paragraph: We reserve the right to change the Terms without prior notice. The latest terms will be displayed on the website or LIFF page.
